recurrent_substructures.evidence: Frozen CTL Archetype A-1a6ffc1535fb is supported by CTL01..CTL06 with axes O/S/T, future_horizon and time_index; claim-level K relations occur in all six.
Frozen probe_P control is present in five claims; A-3e5ade635939 recurs over the same five with O/P/S/T.
criterion_Q is source-declared in all three; frozen A-5e451660bf4e and A-3508ae6dc93c retain Q with P/O/S/T.
partition_Pi is source-declared in both; frozen A-2e72eac51679 retains Pi/Pi/S/S/O/T/K structure across the pair.
Information/evaluation/measurement O nodes participate upstream of later X/K dependence or inference.
Frozen temporal features mark persistence in five claims; these are retained as derived-feature candidates, not literal identity K.

grammar_distinctions_required_by_CTL: K must remain distinct from T: CTL04/CTL05 contain both typed changes/dependences and explicit precedence.
P_in and P_out must remain directionally distinct: CTL03 and CTL05 contain separately frozen intervention and probe nodes.
Q must remain distinct from C: CTL01/03/04 use criteria/orientation, while CTL05 alone supplies an admissibility-style constraint.
Pi must permit functional subsystem decomposition without requiring a physical boundary: CTL02/CTL04.
rho/O must permit information-like and outcome-like traces and must not be terminal-only: CTL03/04/05.
Generic contextual conditions must not be silently collapsed into C.
possible_compression_or_derived_feature_: CTL01 task-relevant/task-irrelevant deviation classes may be derived from Q-conditioned task-cost relevance rather than primitive Pi.
Persistence in CTL01/02/03/04/06 may be representable by typed carry/transport over T, but not by untyped K = I.
CTL06 task-transition change/repeat may eventually be derivable as a K-over-T property, but frozen evidence does not yet license deleting its condition node.
Multiple O_information/O_outcome distinctions can be compressed into oriented boundary-relative rho/O while retaining direction/topology.

potential_threats_to_grammar_v0.evidence: CTL02/03/06 require axis-null condition nodes. Frozen CTL Archetypes independently retain such nodes, including A-debb48298582, A-52ad3ded28e0, A-106c855fd700. They cannot be relabeled C/Q/Pi/P/X without unsupported reinterpretation.
CTL01 has one frozen perturbation-probe P node whose source-grounded description spans both write/perturb and read/probe behavior; the split is not independently frozen.
history_window, future_horizon, recurrence and persistence occur beyond bare succession; this lane does not prove all are derivable from T plus K.
CTL01/03/05/06 are probabilistic claims. Relational K avoids false functionality, but Grammar v0 does not by itself introduce probability measures; no new primitive is claimed here.

counterexample_to_grammar_v0.scope: bounded CTL lane, lossless/exhaustive representation only
counterexample_to_grammar_v0.statement: CTL02, CTL03 and CTL06 contain required contextual-condition nodes that survive frozen reconstruction but have no licensed Grammar-v0 role. This is a counterexample to the claim that the current role vocabulary is losslessly exhaustive on CTL. It does not invalidate the mapped Pi/X/C/Q/P/K/T/rho structure and does not authorize a grammar repair in this lane.
